newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan buys 52,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat at tender.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys 52,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat at tender.

text.p: The Taiwan Flour Mills Association bought 52,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat in two shipments at a tender on Wednesday, traders said.
The milling association placed the tender on behalf of Taiwan's President Enterprise, traders said.
Freight for the first shipment was fixed at U$22.48 per tonne and the second was at U$21.88 per tonne, traders said.
On Tuesday, the association bought 62,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat on behalf of other Taiwan wheat buying companies.
The latest shipments contain dark northern spring (DNS), hard red winter (HRW) and white wheat (WW) and all are slated for delivery from the Pacific Northwest, traders said.
Suppliers Cargill, Louis Dreyfus Corp and Agrex all sold parts of Wednesday's shipments.
